Chapter 672 - 672 Who Is He?

Chapter 672 - 672 Who Is He?

672 Who Is He?

In front of him, a two-headed snake that was more than ten meters thick stood upright like a pillar that supported the sky.

A golden-haired gorilla nearly a hundred meters tall pounded its chest and roared.

A huge black eagle that covered the sky was circling around.

A giant golden scorpion waved its steel pincers.

…

“So many SSS-class exotic beasts!” one of the examiners said in a hoarse voice.

He was the squadron leader of a special ability squadron and had seen quite a few big scenes.

However, at this moment, he could not help but be stunned.

As soon as he said this, the students began to discuss.

“SSS-class exotic beast? All of them?”

“There are so many SSS-class monsters. What should we do now?”

“We’re finished. We’re all finished.”

…

The students’ voices were filled with fear and even despair.

Lin Fan said to Xia Xue, whose face was a little pale, “Don’t worry, I’ll be by your side to protect you.”

His identity, at least in Xia Xue’s eyes right now, was very ordinary and plain.

However, his words made Xia Xue feel at ease immediately.

She nodded vigorously and said, “Yes!”

…

At this moment, three figures that were not particularly tall suddenly appeared in front of the SSS-class exotic beasts.

They were Hu Yixiao, Liu Qi, and Yu Feng.

The three of them swung their fists, kicked, and drew their sabers.

The strong wind whistled, and the aura was terrifying.

Following that, one huge exotic beast after another was sent flying, beheaded, or exploded like a balloon…

This scene stunned everyone, and they kept gasping in admiration.

“That’s Chief Hu and Chief Liu. Who’s the other person?”

“This is too amazing!”

“One move, one kill! Those are SSS-class exotic beasts!”

“The last one is Elder Yu!”

“As expected of the First Chief. He’s too strong!”

“Idol, they’re all my idols!”

…

As SSS-class exotic beasts were dealt with one after another, the students’ initial worry and fear turned into excitement.

They were excited, but Hu Yixiao, Liu Qi, and Yu Feng, who were standing at the front, had ugly expressions on their faces.

Although they had dealt with SSS-class exotic beasts with one move and it seemed very simple, they were using their full strength for each move.

Even they would not be able to take it anymore if they were to continuously use their full strength to attack.

At this moment, in their field of vision, countless exotic beasts appeared in the distance.

Among them were hundreds of SSS-class exotic beasts.

Hu Yixiao panted heavily. “What’s going on in Forbidden Area No. 2? Why are all the mutated beasts going berserk?”

“If you want to know the reason, I’m afraid you’ll have to go to the depths of the forbidden area,” said Liu Qi.

Hu Yixiao shrugged. “Based on the performance of these exotic beasts, wouldn’t they tear me apart?”

“Master, what should we do now? The exotic beasts seem to be about to charge out again.”

Yu Feng stared into the distance and said, “Replenish your strength and hold on!”

After saying that, he took out a nutrient pack and poured it into his mouth.

This was a special nutrient serum.

One was enough to make an ordinary person not eat for a day.

However, Yu Feng, who was ranked second on the Strength Rankings, had only recovered a little bit of his strength.

Of course, it was better than nothing.

Hu Yixiao and Liu Qi also drank a few nutrient serum packs.

At this moment, a large group of exotic beasts suddenly rushed over from afar, and the entire ground trembled again.

“Again!” Hu Yixiao sighed.

As soon as he finished speaking, he suddenly threw a punch.

A large number of low-level exotic beasts were directly turned into meat pies.

Liu Qi and Yu Feng also attacked.

Low-level exotic beasts could not pose any threat to them at all, so it was easy to deal with them.

However, at this moment, more than ten enormous SSS-class exotic beasts rushed out from underground and in the distance.

This caught them off guard.

“F*ck!”

Hu Yixiao shouted and punched with all his might.

Two SSS-class exotic beasts were killed on the spot.

When he threw out his third punch, his strength was a little difficult to sustain. It was actually blocked by the giant lizard.

The giant lizard seized the opportunity and opened its bloody mouth to bite Hu Yixiao.

At this moment, Yu Feng suddenly turned around and cut off the lizard’s head with his saber. Blood splattered everywhere.

“Pay attention to controlling your strength!”

“Yes, Sir!” Hu Yixiao heaved a sigh of relief at first, but then he spoke nervously like a new student.

Hu Yixiao, Liu Qi, and Yu Feng attacked the exotic beasts again.

After eliminating this wave of exotic beasts, they were even more tired.

However, they had no intention of backing down.

This was because this place was close to the exit of the forbidden area.

If they backed down and allowed the exotic beasts to charge out of the forbidden area, it would definitely bring an incomparably terrifying disaster.

They had barely taken a few breaths of rest when the entire forbidden area suddenly shook again.

Moreover, the magnitude of the tremors this time was far greater than before.

Cracks appeared on the ground, and the red trees also tilted and fell.

In the next moment…

Countless exotic beasts rushed over like a flood.

Hu Yixiao, Liu Qi… Even Yu Feng’s expression changed drastically.

“Hurry!” Yu Feng shouted.

The three of them hurriedly attacked.

However, the three of them were already exhausted. How could they deal with so many exotic beasts?

Especially since there were dozens of SSS-class exotic beasts!

The three of them used all their strength, but it was still difficult for them to resist.

The students in the distance seemed to have noticed something unusual.

They felt the terrifying pressure emitted by the mutated beast, and their bodies trembled.

“S-So terrifying…”

“Can the First Chief and the others defeat them?”

“Yes… It should be possible…”

…

Lin Fan just stood beside Xia Xue and looked ahead silently.

He suddenly frowned and said softly, “Xia Xue, wait for me here for a while.”

As soon as he finished speaking, his figure disappeared.

Hu Yixiao had just used all his strength to send a giant golden python flying. Before he could catch his breath, he suddenly felt a chill behind him.

A fiery-red scorpion was flying toward his head with its sharp stinger.

Hu Yixiao wanted to dodge, but it was too late.

Meanwhile, Yu Feng and Liu Qi were dealing with the other SSS-class exotic beasts.

Hu Yixiao felt despair in his heart. “It’s over!”

At this moment, a tall and handsome figure suddenly appeared in front of him.

It was Lin Fan!

Lin Fan pointed at the scorpion that was flying over.

Its sharp and sturdy stinger shattered like a bubble!

No!

It was not just the stinger that shattered.

The huge fiery red scorpion turned into nothingness like a bubble.

This scene stunned Hu Yixiao.

At this moment, Hu Yixiao only had one thought in his mind, ‘Who was he?’
